schemaVersion.description: Raise only for changes older launchers cannot read; they will ask the user to update.

updated.description: Date the catalog was last edited (YYYY-MM-DD).

id.description: Permanent identifier. Also the install folder name. Never change it after release.

tagline.description: One line shown on app cards.

description.description: Plain text. Blank lines separate paragraphs; lines starting with '- ' are bullets.

icon.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 512 KB. Relative to this file, or an absolute URL in a trusted owner's repository.

version.description: Semantic version, e.g. 1.4.0. Raising it offers an update.

executable.description: Program to launch, relative to the root of the package ZIP.

preserve.description: Files or folders inside the install directory to carry over when updating or repairing.

packages.description: One package per architecture. ARM64 PCs fall back to x64 if no arm64 package exists.

url.description: A GitHub Release asset belonging to a trusted owner.

size.description: Exact size of the ZIP in bytes.
